summary: ACRES Commercial Realty Corp. filed an 8-K on November 6, 2026, disclosing entry on November 2, 2026 into the Seventh Amendment to its Master Repurchase and Securities Contract Agreement and Amendment No. 5 to Guaranty with Morgan Stanley Mortgage Capital Holdings LLC, acting as administrative agent, and subsidiary ACRES Real Estate SPE 10, LLC as borrower. The amendment extends the facility to November 2027 and modifies certain financial covenants in the amended guaranty. No pricing, stake, or change-of-control terms are involved; this is a routine financing amendment, not a special situation.
